summary: Iteration 25 (both). Backend: 22/22 live API tests GREEN in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration26_festivals_parties_live.py — Elder-Gods festival calendar endpoint shape, prayers smoke (gods + submit verdict), and the full Party Quests lifecycle (create → 2nd-user join → start with MoC opening → host turn → 2nd-user turn → 409 not-your-turn → leave → host-cannot-leave 409 → finish → 409 not-active) plus guardrails (foreign character 404, duplicate join 409, non-host start 409, unauth 403, 422 validation, non-existent party 404, finished party hidden from default listing but present in /parties/mine). Frontend: /prayers festival-calendar-block renders and expands to all 4 god cards (active=null today, banner correctly absent); /parties create dialog → navigates to /parties/{id}; RECRUITING badge, roster, Start the Scene → IN SESSION with MoC opening in party-scene-log, action input enabled for host, action posted and appended (2 entries, player action_text visible), End Party confirm → ENDED after refresh (verified in DB too). No blocking defects found.

minor.issue: LLM turn narration takes 30-120s under the running image batcher (test suite took ~9 min). Not a defect, but the frontend has no visible per-request timeout guard; consider a client timeout + retry message.

The 'This party is full.' branch could not be exercised live — only 2 real user accounts exist, so a 2-seat party is already full after the 2nd join. Branch is covered by unit test test_party_service.py::test_join_rejects_full_and_duplicate. Seed a 3rd test user if live coverage is desired.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='dashboard-parties-btn' does not appear within 60s on first load; it became visible only after ~60-150s (dashboard renders quick-actions after the slow /api/characters call). Consider rendering quick-actions before character data resolves.

integration_issues.issue: After accepting the confirm prompt, the status badge stayed 'IN SESSION' for >8s (DB already 'finished'); it showed 'ENDED' only after the 6s poll/reload. Optimistic local state update (or awaiting the finish response before re-render) would make the transition feel correct.

issues: MoC narration contained a stray non-English token ('悉知') mid-sentence in gpt-4o output — recommend adding an explicit 'respond in English only' constraint to the MoC system prompt.
Long scene log has an inner scroll container that opens mid-narration, so the first paragraph of the newest entry is visually clipped until the user scrolls up.

action_items: Add an explicit English-only instruction to PartyService._system_prompt to prevent stray CJK tokens in MoC narration.
Optimistically set party status to 'finished' after the finish call resolves so the badge flips immediately instead of waiting for the 6s poll.
Render Dashboard quick actions (incl. dashboard-parties-btn) independently of the slow /api/characters fetch.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/parties.py maps all ValueError to 409 — 'Party not found.' from start/finish/leave/action therefore returns 409 instead of 404; distinguish not-found from conflict.
party_service.leave_party recomputes turn index but if the CURRENT actor leaves the resulting index can point at the next player without narrating a transition; acceptable for MVP but document it.
submit_action loads the entire action history (to_list(length=1000)) on every turn just to compute turn_number; use a count/max query to avoid growth cost.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (3 minor polish items)
